Fit MOSK GP to 2-band synthetic example

This notebook contains the workflow for:

  • loading groundtruth 2-band (MOGP) time-series,
  • fitting a MOSK GP model,
  • checking which posterior draws produce valid covariance matrices, and
  • visualing the posteriors of the valid draws.

library(readr)
library(glue)
library(tictoc)

register_knitr_engine(override = FALSE)

theme_set(theme_bw())
color_scheme_set("viridis") # bayesplot

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))

filename_stub <- "D2-Q1-seed6893-n200-mnar0.3-sigma0.1"

EXECUTE_SAMPLING <- FALSE
# SAMPLING_SEED <- ifelse(EXECUTE_SAMPLING, round(runif(n = 1, 0, 999)), 119)

N_CHAINS <- 6
N_WARMUP <- 1000
N_SAMPLES <- 1000

# Function estimates the mode of a sample
estimate_mode <- function(x) {
  d <- density(x, n = 2^6)
  d$x[which.max(d$y)]
}
D <- 2
Q <- 1

input_df <- read_csv(
  here("data", glue("{filename_stub}-sim.csv")), 
  show_col_types = FALSE)

input_params <- read_tsv(
  here("data", glue("{filename_stub}-param.tsv")), 
  show_col_types = FALSE)

input_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = y, colour = factor(d)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = y + y_se, ymin = y - y_se), colour = "black") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = f), alpha = 0.8) +
  #facet_grid(rows = vars(d), scales = "fixed") +
  labs(colour = "Band")
ns <- table(input_df$d)

Model Fitting

stan_model <- cmdstan_model(here("stan", "moskgp-D2.stan"))

Sampling

data_list <- list(
  N = NROW(input_df),
  ns = ns,
  d = input_df$d,
  x = input_df$t,
  y = input_df$y,
  y_se = input_df$y_se
)
format(start_time <- Sys.time())
[1] "2026-09-24 13:19:39"
if (EXECUTE_SAMPLING) {
  
  output <- stan_model$sample(
    data = data_list,
    #seed = SAMPLING_SEED,
    chains = N_CHAINS,
    parallel_chains = N_CHAINS,
    iter_warmup = N_WARMUP,
    iter_sampling = N_SAMPLES,
    refresh = 500,
    show_exceptions = FALSE,
    show_messages = TRUE
  )
  
  output$save_object(
    here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_moskgp-D2_all.RDS")))
  
} else {
  output <- readRDS(
    here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_moskgp-D2_all.RDS")))
}
format(finish_time <- Sys.time())

Posterior Predictive Check

Target locations

n_star <- 100 # in each band
N_star <- n_star * D
ns_star = rep(n_star, D)

star_df <- data.frame(
  t_star = rep(seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = n_star), D),
  d_star = as.integer(rep(1:D, each = n_star))
)
# Draw posterior predictive samples using the posterior means
posterior_means <- as.data.frame(output_draws) |> 
  select(matches(vars)) |> 
  colMeans()

mean_ws <- posterior_means[c("w[1]", "w[2]")]
mean_Sigmas <- posterior_means[c("Sigma[1]", "Sigma[2]")]
mean_mus <- posterior_means[c("mu[1]", "mu[2]")]
mean_thetas <- posterior_means[c("theta[1]", "theta[2]")]
mean_phis <- posterior_means[c("phi[1]", "phi[2]")]

n_draws <- 10

mean_draws <- postpred_Q1_draws(
  n_draws = n_draws, 
  xs = input_df$t, ys = input_df$y, ys_se = input_df$y_se, ds = input_df$d, ns = ns,  
  xs_star = star_df$t_star, ds_star = star_df$d_star, ns_star = ns_star, 
  D = D, 
  w = mean_ws, Sigma = mean_Sigmas, mu = mean_mus, theta = mean_thetas, phi = mean_phis
)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = mean_draws, 
            aes(x = x_star, y = f_star, 
                colour = d_star,
                group = interaction(d_star,.draw)), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = input_df, aes(x = t, y = y, colour = factor(d)), size = 1) 
# Draw posterior predictive samples using a particular posterior draw
r <- 14
this_w <- output_draws_mat[r, c("w[1]", "w[2]")]
this_Sigma <- output_draws_mat[r, c("Sigma[1]", "Sigma[2]")]
this_mu <- output_draws_mat[r, c("mu[1]", "mu[2]")]
this_theta <- output_draws_mat[r, c("theta[1]", "theta[2]")]
this_phi <- output_draws_mat[r, c("phi[1]", "phi[2]")]

pp_draws <- postpred_Q1_draws(
  n_draws = 10,
  xs = input_df$t, ys = input_df$y, ys_se = input_df$y_se, ds = input_df$d, ns = ns,  
  xs_star = star_df$t_star, ds_star = star_df$d_star, ns_star = ns_star, 
  D = D, 
  w = this_w, Sigma = this_Sigma, mu = this_mu, theta = this_theta, phi = this_phi
)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pp_draws, 
            aes(x = x_star, y = f_star, 
                colour = d_star,
                group = interaction(d_star,.draw)), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = input_df, aes(x = t, y = y, colour = factor(d)), size = 1) 
if (EXECUTE_SAMPLING) {
  
  tic()
  outputs <- check_postpred_draws_validity(
    xs = input_df$t, ys = input_df$y, ys_se = input_df$y_se, ds = input_df$d, ns = ns, 
    xs_star = star_df$t_star, ds_star = star_df$d_star, ns_star = ns_star, 
    D = D, 
    ws = output_draws_mat[,c("w[1]", "w[2]")],
    Sigmas = output_draws_mat[,c("Sigma[1]", "Sigma[2]")],
    mus = output_draws_mat[,c("mu[1]", "mu[2]")],
    thetas = output_draws_mat[,c("theta[1]", "theta[2]")],
    phis = output_draws_mat[,c("phi[1]", "phi[2]")]
  )
  toc()
  
  write_rds(outputs, here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_valid.RDS")))
} else {
  
  outputs <- read_rds(here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_valid.RDS")))
}

Validity checking

if (EXECUTE_SAMPLING) {
  tic()
  valid_draws_checks <- batch_check_K_validity(
    xs = input_df$t, xs_star = star_df$t_star, 
    ds = input_df$d, ds_star = star_df$d_star, 
    ns = ns, ns_star = ns_star,
    D = D,
    ws = output_draws_mat[,c("w[1]", "w[2]")],
    Sigmas = output_draws_mat[,c("Sigma[1]", "Sigma[2]")],
    mus = output_draws_mat[,c("mu[1]", "mu[2]")],
    thetas = output_draws_mat[,c("theta[1]", "theta[2]")],
    phis = output_draws_mat[,c("phi[1]", "phi[2]")]
  )
  toc()
  
  valid_draws_idx <- which(valid_draws_checks == "Valid") #which(valid_draws_checks == "Warning")
  valid_draws_df <- output_draws[valid_draws_idx,]

  write_rds(valid_draws_df, here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_moskgp-D2_post.RDS")))
} else {
  valid_draws_df <- read_rds(here("RDS", glue("{filename_stub}_moskgp-D2_post.RDS")))
}

valid_draws_mat <- as.matrix(valid_draws_df)
